parameters.jsCode:
const j=$json;
const prompt=[
  'Premium vertical LinkedIn business strategy poster background, photorealistic commercial campaign art direction.',
  'Poster archetype: '+j.Poster_Archetype+'.',
  j.Visual_Scene,
  'Palette direction: '+j.Palette_Direction+'.',
  'Bright high-key natural daylight, polished realism, clear visual storytelling and premium SME consulting campaign aesthetic.',
  'One strong central protagonist or focal point. The business idea must be understandable visually in one second without relying on any written information.',
  'Egyptian or Middle Eastern SME context where appropriate. Maximum two prominent human subjects. Natural hands, natural faces, realistic proportions.',
  'Portrait 4:5 composition. Keep important subjects inside the central 70 percent. Keep the upper quarter bright, simple and low-detail for a separate Arabic headline overlay.',
  'CRITICAL: generate only physical real-world objects and people. Never generate any visible text or anything intended to contain text.',
  'No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, signage, posters, price tags, forms, documents, papers with markings, whiteboards, screens, dashboards, charts, maps, process diagrams, flowcharts, UI panels or infographics.',
  'No empty corridor or architecture-only scene. No sci-fi holograms. No generic handshake meeting. No dark cinematic grading.',
  'Premium photorealistic editorial finish, realistic materials, controlled detail, strong physical metaphor.'
].join(' ');
return [{json:{...j,Image_Prompt_Final:prompt}}];
